# Shaynly

> Shaynly is a business marketing and management platform providing strategic frameworks, AI automation architectures, and offline-first client-side web utilities.

## Core Identity & Publishing Entity
- Publisher & Founder: Sivanandan N
- Website: https://shaynly.com/
- HTML Directory: https://shaynly.com/site-map/
- XML Sitemap: https://shaynly.com/sitemap.xml
- AdSense Publisher ID: pub-2218316924082551

## Client-Side Web Utilities (22 Tools)
- [Invoice Generator](https://shaynly.com/tools/invoice.html): Client-side PDF invoice builder with tax calculation.
- [GST Calculator](https://shaynly.com/tools/gst.html): Indian GST forward and reverse rate calculation.
- [QR Studio](https://shaynly.com/tools/qr-studio.html): High-resolution vector QR code generation.
- [Brand Kit Generator](https://shaynly.com/tools/brandkit.html): Color palette and typography token generation.
- [UTM Campaign Builder](https://shaynly.com/tools/utm.html): Analytics campaign parameter string builder.
- [Robots & LLMs Generator](https://shaynly.com/tools/robots-llms.html): robots.txt and llms.txt standard builder.
- [Schema Generator](https://shaynly.com/tools/schema.html): JSON-LD structured data generator.

## Key Strategic Categories
- Artificial Intelligence & Automation
- Digital Marketing & SEO (Rank Math, Google Search Console, SERP Analysis)
- Lean Six Sigma & DMAIC Frameworks
- Financial & Percentage Calculators
